# apple_subscription_plan_availability (Resource)

Sets the territories where a subscription plan is sold. Creating the resource for a plan that already has an availability manages it. App Store Connect can't delete an availability, so destroying the resource leaves it. Import it with `<subscription_id>/<plan_type>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_territories" "all" {}

resource "apple_subscription_plan_availability" "upfront" {
  subscription_id              = apple_subscription.monthly.id
  plan_type                    = "UPFRONT"
  available_in_new_territories = true
  territories                  = data.apple_territories.all.ids
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `available_in_new_territories` (Boolean) Whether the plan becomes available in territories the App Store adds later.
- `plan_type` (String) Plan: `UPFRONT` for the whole period at once, `MONTHLY` for a yearly plan billed monthly.
- `subscription_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the subscription, e.g. `apple_subscription.example.id`.
- `territories` (Set of String) Territories where the plan is sold, e.g. `USA`; see `data.apple_territories`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the plan availability.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_subscription_plan_availability.upfront
  identity = {
    subscription_id = "6446452616"
    plan_type       = "UPFRONT"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `plan_type` (String) Plan type, e.g. `UPFRONT`.
- `subscription_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the subscription.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_subscription_plan_availability.upfront 6446452616/UPFRONT
```
